definitions.explanation: The amount of money required to purchase something.
The importance or usefulness of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.notes: 値が高い = expensive (lit. price is high)

examples.japanese: {値|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げてください→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, the price of vegetables has been going up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見合|みあ}った→見合う：14391_miau⟧⟦{値|ね}{打|う}ち→値打ち：17452_neuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It has worth commensurate with the effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{代|か}えがたい→代える：11717_kaeru⟧⟦{値|ね}{打|う}ち→値打ち：17452_neuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Experience has a value that cannot be replaced by anything.

notes:
USAGE: {値|ね} refers to price or value. It's commonly used in expressions about pricing and worth. Note: ⟦{値|あたい}→値：21704_atai⟧ can also be read as あたい (value, especially in math/science).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧／⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (expensive/cheap)
- {値|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧／⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (to raise/lower the price)
- {値|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧／⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ (price goes up/down)
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧ (price)
- ⟦{値引|ねび}き→値引き：05424_nebiki⟧ (discount)
- ⟦{値打|ねう}ち→値打ち：17452_neuchi⟧ (value, worth)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧ (price - most common word for price)
- ⟦{値札|ねふだ}→値札：09532_nefuda⟧ (price tag)
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧ (list price, fixed price)

NOTE: {値段|ねだん} is the most common word for 'price' in everyday contexts.
